prompt: A hyper-realistic futuristic hyperloop transportation system set in Tokyo, featuring sleek and elegant high-speed pods traveling inside transparent tubes elevated above the urban landscape. The tubes are illuminated with soft purple and silver lighting, reflecting the branding of Ikimirai. The scene is set in a futuristic Tokyo, blending traditional Japanese architecture with modern high-tech urban design. Surrounding the hyperloop are clean, eco-friendly energy sources such as solar panels and lush greenery. The atmosphere is dynamic yet serene, showcasing a harmonious integration of technology, culture, and sustainability. Highly detailed, cinematic, with a focus on the transparent tubes, the rapid motion of the hyperloop pods, and the vibrant lights of Tokyo’s skyline at dusk. --v 6.1
